name: Kevin Estis
biography: has over 17 years experience in finding bad people on good networks...and vice-versa. His Master's project in Digital Forensics was on Apple TV forensics so that he could convince he wife that an Apple TV would be put to good use. Since then he's broken and fixed the Apple TV more times than he can count.
